description: Empirical power matrix collapsed to a 1-D lookup of electrical power vs significant wave height Hs at representative energy period Te=9 s. P = J(Hs,Te)*width*CWR*eta_turbine*eta_generator, where J=(rho*g^2/64pi)*Hs^2*Te. Capped at rated power.

Te_ref_s.note: Representative energy period for the lookup

P_rated_kw.note: Rated electrical power (curve clipped at rating)

power_kw.note: Electrical power at Te=9 s, clipped at 80 kW rated

source: Falnes (2002), Ocean Waves and Oscillating Systems; EMEC device performance data; reuses EC134 F1a parameters
